WITH july AS (
  SELECT SUM(order_items.product_price) AS revenue_jul
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" AS order_items
  WHERE order_items.ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND order_items.ordered_at < '2025-08-01'
),
august AS (
  SELECT SUM(order_items.product_price) AS revenue_aug
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" AS order_items
  WHERE order_items.ordered_at >= '2025-08-01' AND order_items.ordered_at < '2025-09-01'
)
SELECT
  july.revenue_jul AS revenue_jul_2025,
  august.revenue_aug AS revenue_aug_2025,
  (august.revenue_aug - july.revenue_jul) * 100.0 / july.revenue_jul AS revenue_change_pct
FROM july, august;
